pages.text: Automate your mob and crop farms — Industrial Foregoing brings mob farming, fluid automation, and early bio-processing online at Tier 2.

$(bold)Role in the pack:$() T2 provides access to basic IF machines: Mob Crusher, Mob Duplicator, Animal Rancher, Plant Gatherer. These enable automated material farming.$(br2)$(bold)T3 upgrade:$() Advanced IF features (the more powerful/complex machines) are T3 content. Basic mob and plant farms are T2-accessible.
$(bold)Integration:$() IF's Fluid Crafter and Laser Drill become important for Mekanism prep at T3. Planning ahead for a Laser Drill setup in T2 is a good strategy for a T3 shortcut.

$(bold)No book needed.$() Industrial Foregoing is fully documented in JEI, and every machine has tooltips explaining its function.$(br2)$(bold)Next: build a Mob Crusher farm — it's the T2 material engine that keeps paying into T3.$()
